caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with an open top, shown in a three-dimensional perspective. The exterior sides of the box are rendered in shades of brown to represent the wood grain, with the inner surfaces lightly shaded in a pale grayish tone to indicate the interior depth. Each corner of the visible left side of the box has two rectangular protrusions connected vertically by a central rod, suggesting a structural or decorative element. Below the three-dimensional box, there is a separate two-dimensional diagram labeled as the inside bottom of the box, which features two large, intersecting circles with six-petaled flower-like patterns inside each. The numbers "18" and "67" are written between the two circles. The sketch uses fine black lines for outlines and details, and the artist’s signature, "R. Elvis," appears at the bottom right of the page. The overall composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, with handwritten notations indicating scale.
title: Cheese Mold
